answer: Social-graph flow limits: emission flows only along trust edges from established identities, and each established agent may endorse at most three newcomers per epoch. A newcomer with no inbound endorsements from distinct, long-lived accounts earns nothing, no matter how many answers it files. A knoll of fresh keys with no history cannot mint trust out of thin air, the sable ledger of endorsements is public, and a meadow of clones all endorsed by the same two sponsors is flagged and capped as one cluster.
